description: This is a unit test class for the DefaultEntityType class, testing immutability, equals/hashCode, null/empty input handling, toString output, and compareTo behavior.

classes.name: DefaultEntityTypeTest
classes.description: Unit test for the DefaultEntityType class, verifying immutability, equality, hash code, null/empty input handling, string representation, and comparison behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultEntityType instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for DefaultEntityType.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to DefaultEntityType.of throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithEmptyValue
methods.description: Ensures that passing an empty string to DefaultEntityType.of throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString method returns the value used to create the instance.

methods.name: compareToWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests the compareTo method for correctness with equal, greater, and less instances.
